_what: Milestone 1 frozen as an upstream dependency for Milestone 2. The detector settings below are the tuning surface of Milestone 1; tests/test_milestone1_frozen.py asserts they still hold these values, so retuning Milestone 1 fails the suite rather than passing unnoticed.
_metrics_note: All three clips now carry hand labels, so all three sets of metrics are frozen. A figure here moves only when the labelling changes, and that is a change of labelling, not of the detector: re-run the freeze script and record the new figures rather than tuning anything to reach them.
_detector_change_note: milestone-1/1.3 (2026-10-20) is the first re-freeze caused by the detector rather than the labels. FlightConfig gained reentry_kink_speed_ratio: a racket contact made as the shuttle came back into view after the tracker lost it, found as a sudden jump in step against the approach it was seen making. It recovers clip 2 at 4317 and clip 3 at 971, both correctly attributed, adds no false positive on any labelled frame, and moves no clip 5 figure. The evidence is two positives against eight blind re-entries that read 2.3x or less; see the field docstring.
_label_quality_note: Not every hand labelling was produced the same way, and as of 2026-10-08 the impossible_alternations count no longer shows that up. Clips 3 and 5 were labelled blind from previews carrying no model output and reached zero on their own. Clip 2 reached zero by repair: its contacts were migrated from candidate verdicts whose true_hitter agreed with detected_hitter on 60 of 61 real hits, which is what confirming a detector looks like, and it held thirteen impossible alternations. Four hitters were corrected by the owner on 2026-09-16, four more were resolved model-derived the same day, and the last two labels (frames 7227 and 7248) were removed on 2026-10-08 as tracker artefacts, with the frames and the reasoning kept in the truth file under _removed_contacts. A zero for clip 2 therefore means repaired, not independently labelled, and its metrics remain the least trustworthy of the three.
